title: Character sheet
description: One figure in the 1808 Kushun Kotan Omusha diorama. Every factual claim carries a source.

name.description: A role-based name (e.g. 'Aizu interpreter') unless a historical name is documented.

variant.description: What tells this figure apart from others with the same name (e.g. the robe). Used only in lists for the team, not in the visitor's view.

perspective.description: The source perspective this character mainly speaks from.

status.description: Only curator-reviewed sheets should be presented as reviewed.

summary.description: One or two sentences shown when the figure is tapped.

knows.description: What the figure would plausibly know as of 1808.

does_not_know.description: Things after 1808, or outside the figure's position, that it must not speak to.

declines.description: Topics the character declines to speculate on (required for Ainu characters: belief, inner opinion of the ceremony).

register.description: Speech register, e.g. formal samurai official, plain soldier.

routes_through.description: Character id of the interpreter, for Ainu figures in interpreter mode.

appearance.description: What the figure looks like (clothing, hair); used for 3D reconstruction and alt text.

src.description: GLB for the close-up view, relative to src/index.html.

label.description: Developer note on how the model was made. The app shows the matching Form instead (envelopes/forms.json): its kind, reality basis and what was never captured.

hotspot.description: Optional default position in splat-local coordinates; src/hotspots.json takes precedence.
